criteria.requirement: Fix tasklists_plugin(label=True, label_after=True) to wrap existing parsed inline children with a paired label after the checkbox, never popping a content/closing token or reinserting raw Markdown as HTML. Preserve rich emphasis/link/image/multiline content exactly once, HTML-disabled escaping, matching generated id/for, nested list structure and enabled/disabled checkbox behavior. Default no-label and ordinary wrapping-label modes remain unchanged. Do not flatten parsed children to unescaped text or merely hide duplicated output.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
